diagnosis.what_happened: Section headings for questions and hypotheses lacked the explicit prefix 'سوال اول:' and 'فرضیه اول:', subheadings contained redundant repetitions like 'پایه تحصیلی (*پایه تحصیلی*)', and unparsed raw markdown syntax (such as blockquotes '>', horizontal rules '---', and unparsed asterisks) leaked into the generated Word DOCX deliverable.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Incomplete heading standardization and naive line-by-line markdown-to-docx parsers fail to strip markdown artifacts, resulting in unscholarly presentation and supervisor rejection.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: 1) Every question section must be titled with 'سوال [عدد ترتیبی]: ...' and every hypothesis section with 'فرضیه [عدد ترتیبی]: ...'. 2) Subheadings must be clean without parenthetical variable repetition. 3) DOCX generation parsers must thoroughly strip all raw markdown syntax (>, ---, stray asterisks, hashes) and correctly render formatting.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Adherence to institutional thesis templates demands clear, standardized question and hypothesis demarcations, concise subheadings, and zero raw markdown artifacts in final OpenXML Word deliverables.

desired_behavior: Enforce 'سوال اول: ...' and 'فرضیه اول: ...' section titles, clean non-redundant subheadings, and complete elimination of raw markdown artifacts in Word output.
generalization: Universally structure all Chapter 4 empirical sections with explicit question/hypothesis prefixes and ensure all Markdown export engines strip raw markdown meta-characters.

evidence.observed_value: Missing standard prefixes, repeated headers, raw markdown in DOCX
evidence.threshold_value: Standard prefixes present, clean headers, zero raw markdown in DOCX
